study: Chosen-input orbit verification of the sequence-permutation profile implemented by Hidden No More
scope: Layer0 public Llama3.2-1B embeddings passed through unchanged upstream protection/permutation function; no matching attack, key estimation, victim recovery, or full-model inference
sample_source: Existing WildChat3000 manifest; deterministic English lexical units drawn from lifecycle100, not a new corpus or an independent100-prompt recovery study
anchor_selection: Two distinct eligible one-token leading-space lexical units per existing heuristic category; scan frozen lifecycle IDs in order and words in text order
expected_exact_orbit: b!/product(token-multiplicity factorials); BOS is a real distinguished token, no added recovery marker
comparison: Exact tensor bytes define distinct output states; no tolerance-based cluster merging
control: Registered multiplicity controls; native no-permutation None sanity; identical RNG seeded across dtype/lexical conditions; all original wrong/negative outcomes retained
accounting: Every registered anchor×b×condition×dtype×profile must be present exactly once; retain unique tensors and every trial permutation
exclusions: No claim that the SD full randomization collapses to b when its column permutation is refreshed
No claim that post-attention hidden states have identical repeated-token rows
No new break of GELO default or STIP column permutation
No implication that orbit counts establish key recovery or content recovery
paper_decision: Accept raw/operator integrity first; report the actual orbit and controls without changing existing formal arguments
